title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Measurement Tariff: Additional Measured Zones
content:
**Rule.** Measuring additional zones adds a zone add-on to the Repair Estimates & Appointments measurement charge: an estimate total of at least **20,000.00 USD** (20000) with a teardown span — the calendar days from the check-in date to the estimate written date — of at least **4** days adds **90.00 USD**; exactly one of those two conditions adds **45.00 USD**; neither adds none.

The estimate total is the booking's current estimate total (parts, labor, materials and sublet, before any deductible).

| Estimate total of at least 20,000.00 USD | Teardown span of at least 4 days | Zone add-on |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 90.00 USD |
| Yes | No | 45.00 USD |
| No | Yes | 45.00 USD |
| No | No | none |

**Boundary cases** (hypothetical estimates)

- 20,000.00 USD is at least 20,000.00; 19,999.99 USD is not.
- Checked in 8 July and written 12 July: 4 days, at least 4; written 11 July: 3 days.
- 20,000.00 USD, checked in 8 July, written 12 July: both — 90.00 USD.
- 19,999.99 USD, checked in 8 July, written 12 July: exactly one — 45.00 USD.
- 15,000.00 USD, checked in 8 July, written 10 July: neither — none.
